summary: GoPro filed an 8-K reporting Item 2.02 results-related disclosure combined with Item 4.02 non-reliance on previously issued financial statements, and an Item 8.01 other-events note referencing a pending Agreement and Plan of Merger dated September 1, 2026 among the Company, Action Acquisitions LLC and Starman Optical, Inc. Restatement errors concern liability-classified warrant measurement with Mateo Financing, LLC (issued August 4, 2025; repriced November 5, 2025) plus bifurcation of an embedded conversion derivative on 2026 convertible debentures sold to YA II PN, Ltd. Revenue, cash and operating cash flow are unaffected; only net loss and non-cash reconciling items change. No deal terms or board recommendation disclosed here.
